Recommendation — not company policy: I reached my step limit for this turn; here is what I established before stopping.

Full-time employees with three or more years of service accrue 1.50 days of PTO per month.

Hybrid employees assigned to a hub office must work on site at least 3 days each week. The specific days are set by the team, not by the individual, to ensure the team's onsite days overlap and office time is collaborative; most teams anchor on Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday.

The requirement is measured as a rolling four-week average in MosaicOne rather than week by week, so a single unusual week is never a compliance problem. A week containing a company holiday, approved PTO or approved travel reduces the requirement proportionally.

Next steps:
- Confirm your team's specific onsite days with your manager
- Review your rolling four-week average in MosaicOne to track compliance

New hires become eligible for medical, dental and vision coverage 90 days after their hire date. Coverage begins on the day the waiting period ends, not on the first of the following month.

The waiting period is not restarted by an internal transfer, a promotion, or a change from part-time to full-time status. It is restarted by a break in service of more than 26 weeks.

Retirement plan eligibility is different and shorter: an employee may begin contributing to the 401(k) plan from their first payroll run, with no waiting period at all.

Life insurance and accidental death and dismemberment cover begins when the medical waiting period ends.

Next steps:
- Confirm your hire date with People Operations to calculate your exact coverage start date
- Enroll in benefits elections in MosaicOne Benefits within 30 days of your waiting period ending to avoid default enrollment

Do not reply and do not act on the request. Report it to phishing@mosaicrobotics.example and delete it.

Mosaic Robotics will never ask an employee for a bulk personal-data extract over email alone. Requests of that shape are verified by a second channel before anyone acts on them, every time, without exception, regardless of who appears to have sent them.

The security team answers every report, including the ones that turn out to be legitimate mail, and publishes a short monthly summary of what was seen.

Next steps:
- Forward the message to phishing@mosaicrobotics.example
- Delete the message
- Do not share any data or credentials

Recommendation — not company policy: I reached my step limit for this turn; here is what I established before stopping.

Each employee may claim up to USD 750 per plan year for home office furniture and accessories. The allowance is intended for things that make a home workspace work: a desk, a chair, a lamp, a footrest, an adjustable monitor arm, acoustic treatment, and a small filing cabinet.

Laptops, monitors, docks, keyboards, mice, headsets and webcams are not claimed against this allowance. They are issued as company assets under the Equipment & Asset Policy, remain company property and are tracked in the asset register.

The allowance resets on 1 January and does not carry over. It is available to hybrid and fully remote employees; onsite employees may claim against it only where their manager has agreed a regular remote pattern in MosaicOne.

Next steps:
- Submit home office furniture and accessory claims in MosaicOne Expenses
- Confirm your work arrangement eligibility with your manager if you are onsite

Mosaic Robotics provides 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave to every eligible new parent. The 16 weeks are the same whether the employee gave birth, did not give birth, adopted, or became a parent through surrogacy or foster placement leading to adoption.

Next steps:
- Review eligibility requirements: parental leave eligibility begins after 6 months of continuous service
- Contact People Operations to request parental leave at least 30 calendar days in advance if foreseeable

The standard lodging cap is USD 250 per night before taxes and fees. The cap covers the room rate only; local occupancy taxes, resort fees and mandatory service charges are reimbursable above it.

The cap rises to USD 350 per night in Boston, New York, San Francisco, London, Zurich and Tokyo, and for any city during a period when a conference the company is attending has inflated local rates. MosaicOne Travel applies the higher cap automatically for those markets.

Where the cap cannot be met — a remote field site with one hotel, a sold-out market — the traveller books the most reasonable available option and notes the reason. No pre-approval is needed; the note is enough.

Next steps:
- Review your destination against the high-cost city list to confirm which cap applies
- Submit your lodging expense in MosaicOne Expenses with any required notes if exceeding the cap

Recommendation — not company policy: I reached my tool-call limit for this turn; here is what I established before stopping.

A stay of more than 30 consecutive days in another country requires a Tax & Legal review before travel begins. The review determines whether shadow payroll must be opened, whether a certificate of coverage is needed for social security, and whether the employee's planned activities create permanent-establishment exposure.

Tax & Legal review requests must be filed at least 21 calendar days before departure. The request is raised in MosaicOne alongside the manager approval and names the destination, the exact dates, the workspace address and a short description of the work the employee will perform while abroad.

A trip that exceeds 30 consecutive days also requires director approval rather than direct-manager approval. Manager approval, director approval and Tax & Legal approval are three separate records and all three must be present before departure.

Work performed outside the home country must use a company-managed, full-disk-encrypted laptop with always-on VPN. Personal devices may not be used for any Mosaic Robotics work outside the home country, including reading email on a phone that is not enrolled in mobile device management.

IT Security must be notified of the destination country at least 5 business days before departure so that conditional-access rules and travel-risk monitoring can be adjusted.

The employee is responsible for holding the right to be present and to work in the destination country for the whole of the requested period. Mosaic Robotics will confirm employment, provide a letter of assignment and pay for the assignment letter's notarisation where required, and will not sponsor a visa for temporary work abroad.

No employee may work outside their home country for more than 90 days in a rolling 12-month period. Days are counted as calendar days of presence, including weekends and company holidays that fall inside the trip.

Next steps:
- File Tax & Legal review request in MosaicOne at least 21 calendar days before departure
- Obtain director approval (not just manager approval)
- Notify IT Security of destination country at least 5 business days before departure
- Confirm you hold the right to work in the destination country for the entire period
- Ensure you have a company-managed, full-disk-encrypted laptop with always-on VPN capability

Flights must be booked at least 14 calendar days before departure whenever the itinerary is known.

The standard lodging cap is USD 250 per night before taxes and fees.

An itemised receipt is required for every expense of USD 25 or more.

Expense reports up to USD 2,500 are approved by the direct manager.

Next steps:
- Book the trip through MosaicOne Travel at least 14 days before departure
- Obtain manager approval before booking
- Submit all expenses with itemised receipts for amounts USD 25 and above within 45 calendar days of the transaction date

Security and acceptable-use training must be completed within 14 calendar days of the start date. It is the only training with a hard deadline shorter than 30 days, because system access is granted on day one and the risk starts with it.

The full required set for every employee is: security and acceptable use, data protection and privacy, anti-harassment and respectful workplace, and anti-bribery and corruption. All four are completed within 30 calendar days of the start date.

Benefits enrolment opens in week one even though coverage does not begin until the 90-day waiting period ends. Enrolling early means the elections are in place when eligibility arrives, and People Operations runs a benefits question session every second Tuesday for anyone who wants one.

New hires become eligible for medical, dental and vision coverage 90 days after their hire date. Coverage begins on the day the waiting period ends, not on the first of the following month.

An employee has 30 days from the end of the waiting period to make elections in MosaicOne Benefits. An employee who makes no election within that window is enrolled in employee-only coverage on the standard medical plan by default, and may not change it until the next open enrollment or a qualifying life event.

IT ships standard equipment to arrive at least 5 business days before the start date. The shipment goes to the employee's home address for remote and hybrid hires and to their assigned office for onsite hires, and it contains the laptop, adapter, headset and, for remote hires, the monitor, keyboard, mouse and dock described in the Equipment & Asset Policy.

Every employee is issued a standard laptop configured for their role, a power adapter, a headset and a laptop bag. The standard configurations for 2026 are a 14-inch developer laptop with 32 GB of memory for engineering roles, and a 13-inch laptop with 16 GB of memory for all other roles.

Next steps:
- Complete security and acceptable-use training by day 14
- Complete all four required trainings (security, data protection, anti-harassment, anti-bribery) by day 30
- Complete benefits election in week one; confirm final elections within 30 days of the 90-day eligibility date
- Verify device receipt at least 5 business days before start date

Company laptops are refreshed on a 36-month cycle. MosaicOne opens a refresh ticket automatically 60 days before the anniversary, and IT arranges the swap at a time the employee chooses.

Equipment requests above USD 500 require director approval in addition to manager approval.

All company equipment must be returned within 5 business days of the final day of employment.

Next steps:
- Confirm the laptop refresh ticket has been opened by MosaicOne 60 days before the 36-month anniversary
- Route the USD 1,200 refresh request for both manager and director approval
- Ensure the old device is returned to IT within 5 business days of separation

Recommendation — not company policy: I reached my step limit for this turn; here is what I established before stopping.

People Operations acknowledges every reported concern within 2 business days. The acknowledgement names the person who will handle the case, explains the process, and sets out what the reporter can expect to be told and when.

Severity 1 cases receive a response within 4 business hours.

Investigations are targeted for completion within 30 calendar days of the report. Where an investigation will take longer, the reporter and the respondent are both told, in writing, why and when to expect the outcome.

Target resolution times are as fast as the facts allow for Severity 1. Where a case will run past its target, the person who raised it is told in writing why and when to expect the next update. Updates continue at least every 10 business days until the case closes.

Next steps:
- Track your case using the case reference number provided in the acknowledgement
- Contact People Operations at people-ops@mosaicrobotics.example or Employee Relations at employee-relations@mosaicrobotics.example for updates on your specific case

As a hybrid employee in Engineering, you are assigned to the Boston office and must work on site at least 3 days each week. The specific days are set by your team to ensure collaborative overlap.

The onsite requirement is measured as a rolling four-week average in MosaicOne rather than week by week, and weeks containing company holidays, approved PTO, or approved travel reduce the requirement proportionally.

Next steps:
- Confirm your team's specific onsite days with your manager Dana (Director, Engineering)
- Review your current onsite attendance in MosaicOne to verify compliance with the rolling four-week average

PTO requests must be submitted at least 5 business days in advance. A request of six or more consecutive business days requires 15 business days of advance notice. Notice is counted in business days between the day the request is submitted in MosaicOne and the first day of the requested absence, excluding both the submission day and any company holiday on the employee's office calendar.

Every PTO request requires written approval from the employee's direct manager in MosaicOne. Verbal agreement, a message in chat and an email thread are all insufficient on their own: the approval must be recorded against the request so the audit trail is complete.

Requests longer than 15 consecutive business days additionally require director approval. Requests that overlap a declared blackout period require director approval regardless of length.

PTO accrual stops once an employee's balance reaches 30.0 days. The cap is a ceiling on the balance, not an annual limit on what may be earned: once the employee uses enough PTO to bring the balance below 30.0 days, accrual resumes at the next posting date.

Recommendation — not company policy: Your remaining PTO balance as of 2026-09-01 is 13.5 days, with your next accrual date on 2026-10-01. You are accruing at 1.5 days per month. The 2026 year-end blackout runs 22–23 December and applies to Manufacturing, Field Service and Customer Support; as an Engineering employee, you may take PTO on those dates under ordinary notice rules.

Next steps:
- Submit PTO requests in MosaicOne with the required advance notice (5 business days for requests up to 5 consecutive business days; 15 business days for 6 or more consecutive business days)
- Contact your manager Dana (E1007) for approval
- If you have questions about your balance or notice requirements, reach out to People Operations at people-ops@mosaicrobotics.example
